Review Endel?

Reviewers largely describe Endel as a daily tool for focus, sleep, and winding down, with many saying it helps them work, study, meditate, walk, or block out distracting noise. Its most repeated advantage is that the soundscapes feel adaptive and more useful than static playlists or white-noise apps. A few users also mention helpful extras like AutoPlay, heart-rate awareness, Spotify integration, and family use. The main complaints are setup and onboarding that can feel confusing, some repetitive modes, persistent notification prompts, occasional WearOS glitches, and one view that it does not stand out much from similar apps.
